item.title: Incarico post-doc: ncarico Post-Doc - GEOS-01/C - Effects of saltwater intrusion on mercury mobility in coastal contaminated soils (Univ. TRIESTE)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-10 23:59
Institution: Univ. TRIESTE, Trieste
Field: Earth sciences / 04/GEOS-01 Mineralogia, petrologia, geochimica, vulcanologia, georisorse e applicazioni

The candidate will investigate the effects of salinity variations on mercury mobility in coastal groundwater. Specifically, the research activities will involve groundwater monitoring with recording of physico-chemical parameters and the execution of related compositional and speciation analyses on groundwater and soil, along with the investigation of the biogeochemical processes regulating mercury mobility under different salinity conditions, in support of the definition of environmental management strategies. The post-doctoral researcher will contribute to third-mission activities and to teaching activities within Bachelor and/or Master degree programs, as well as to laboratory activities…
